desc: 侧缝开衩毛边短袖配松紧腰侧织带七分裤，一套穿好男童夏日出街
leaf: 男童侧缝开衩毛边宽松短袖配松紧腰侧织带七分裤两件套
name: 男童侧开衩毛边短袖织带七分裤款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清是一整套两件而不是单件上衣，用暖纸白底的干净挂摊抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
主图一秒法则：把整套上身的廓形与头号利益一次讲完，靠颈部以下裁切与印刷大字承接源图首屏的海报语感。
shots.textZone: one oversized dry-brush headline on the amber band across the lower quarter, one sans subline beneath it, one graphite caption tab at the upper left

shots.intent: 放大这类版型最容易翻车的一处：侧缝毛边洗后内卷、开衩扭成麻花，让家长在右格直接看到织带压边的解法。
shots.textZone: one short label slot centred under each panel

shots.intent: 用织面与裁口微距替掉空洞面料话术，肉眼看见纱线捻度与毛边锁边，把做工做成可见证据。
shots.textZone: one caption slot inside each of the three hexagon cells along the lower rail

shots.intent: 把源图三格编号亮点条转成可复用语法：三处做法各占一格、各挂一枚编号旗，序号位留空由卖家填。
shots.textZone: one label slot under each of the three panels, each triangle flag left as a blank numeral slot

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子出门跑动的状态：低机位把七分长度与侧开衩的活动量讲可信，儿童面容一律不入镜。
连拍第二格补正面看不到的信息：正后平视的背面轮廓加一枚错位叠格，让版型松量与后背图位同时可信。
同一屏看全源图所载三个配色的正面与背面，选色选码一步到位，降低因看不清背面而退换的概率。
shots.textZone: one header slot above the board and one colourway label slot above each of the three columns

shots.intent: 把源图的商品信息栏与四档指数条转成结构化空格位：行标题保留、取值一律留空，消掉规格疑虑又不编造。
shots.textZone: header slot on the upper card, four row titles and four empty indicator rails on the lower card, every value cell left blank

shots.intent: 回答勒不勒腰、跑跑就掉这类最后疑问：腰头褶皱量、抽绳末端与外缝织带在一格里给实拍证据。
shots.textZone: one caption slot above the amber hairline rule

shots.intent: 收口：把整套折叠样、一册印样接触表与留空的资质位与按钮位摆在同一屏，用可核对的实物与留白空位收住风险而不编造任何结论。
shots.textZone: header slot at the top and one short note line above the credential card, seal outline and button slot stay blank

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm chalk paper sweep #F4EFE5 as the recurring field for packshot, detail strip, poster and split screens, warm asphalt-taupe paper wall and floor #7A736A as the second ground for worn and variant screens, deep graphite panel #33302B reserved for the specification screen and for hard-edged caption tabs, amber #E4761E only ever as one headline band, one hairline rule or one index tick, never as a full field; a fine halftone dot screen in #33302B may run along one frame edge and never crosses the garment; no outdoor ground, no furnished interior, no second wall colour
style.direction: warm printed-lookbook kids apparel commerce, riso-zine collage discipline with rectilinear hard-edged cards and clean infographic control
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside hexagon outline cells in #33302B, plus one solid corner-triangle index flag in #E4761E whose numeral slot stays blank, plus one blank hexagon seal outline on the closing screen; no circular icon plates, no round magnifier windows, no circular photo masks, no square index chips, no scalloped seals, no certificate or badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: warm daylight-balanced 5000K softbox key from the upper left with a large bounce card on the shadow side, low contrast, soft wrap into the paper wall, true contact shadow under every hem and every card edge, glancing warm sidelight only on the two texture screens, no harsh speculars, no cool cast, no coloured gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm printed-lookbook children's apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm chalk paper sweep #F4EFE5, warm asphalt-taupe paper ground #7A736A, graphite ink and card frames #33302B and one amber spot #E4761E used only as a headline band, a hairline rule or an index tick; warm daylight-balanced 5000K softbox key from the upper left with a large bounce fill, low contrast and true contact shadows under every hem; one oversized dry-brush display headline reserved for two poster screens and never carrying a fact, plus one modern geometric sans-serif for all labels; hard-edged offset cards on one grid unit, a fine halftone dot screen along one frame edge, print crop marks, solid corner-triangle index flags with blank numeral slots and thin-line icons inside hexagon outline cells; the top and the cropped bottom always read as one set at stable scale, every worn frame cropped from the neck down or seen from behind so no child face appears, and the slanted rectangular graphic zone on the garment named structurally and never redrawn; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no circular masks or magnifier windows, no taped photo cards.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond the single amber spot
no mixed fonts, no serif and no brush lettering on any factual label
no random backgrounds, no outdoor street ground, no furnished room and no real signage
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no circular photo masks, no round magnifier windows, no taped cards and no seal artwork
no identifiable child face, no teen or adult proportions and no adult styling on children's garments
no redrawn garment graphics, no legible characters, numerals or years inside any graphic zone and no third-party character marks or trademark graphics
style.presentationRules: the top and the cropped bottom always read as one set at one scale across screens, hero scale never shifting more than five percent between screens; every worn frame is a generic child body cropped from the neck down or seen from behind, never an identifiable face; the slanted rectangular graphic zone on the body of the top is named structurally, kept square-on and unobstructed and never redrawn; the raw-cut side slit, the woven outer-seam tape and the gathered elastic waistband stay readable in at least three screens; both pieces appear together whenever the outfit is shown
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm chalk paper sweep #F4EFE5 used both as backdrop and as the card stock of every inset, matte asphalt-taupe paper floor #7A736A for worn and variant boards, graphite board #33302B under the specification card; hard-edged cards sit square or offset by exactly one grid unit, no tape, no props, garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free
style.typography: one oversized dry-brush display headline used only as a graphic band on the two poster screens and never carrying a fact, plus one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-46pt, subline 14-18pt, label 11-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no serif, no script for factual labels, no outline lettering, no wall signage wording
